name: smartmess-monorepo
description: Smart Mess Management & Student Food Wastage Analyser Application Suite

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix mess/backend && npm install --prefix mess/frontend && npm install --prefix student/backend && npm install --prefix student/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "MESS-API,MESS-UI,STU-API,STU-UI" -c "blue,cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix mess/backend" "npm run dev --prefix mess/frontend" "npm run dev --prefix student/backend" "npm run dev --prefix student/frontend"
scripts.dev:mess: concurrently -n "MESS-API,MESS-UI" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix mess/backend" "npm run dev --prefix mess/frontend"
scripts.dev:student: concurrently -n "STU-API,STU-UI" -c "green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix student/backend" "npm run dev --prefix student/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix mess/frontend && npm run build --prefix student/frontend
